TE.evaluation_regime: in_sample_all_eligible; not comparable to temporal holdout

data_quality.target_definition: mean PPG across T+1 and T+2; partial horizons remain eligible

technique_screen.outer_design: expanding time; train seasons strictly before test feature season
technique_screen.hyperparameters: fixed screen values; formal bakeoff must use nested expanding-time tuning
technique_screen.uncertainty: player-cluster bootstrap 90% interval on pooled RMSE improvement versus naive

interpretation_rules: Raw Ridge coefficients are not comparable because active Engine B did not scale inputs.
One-standard-deviation effects are descriptive, conditional, and not causal importance.
TE active report is in-sample and cannot be compared to QB/RB/WR temporal holdouts.
The technique screen is directional only; promotion requires preregistered nested walk-forward evidence.
Market data is excluded from predictive inputs and may be used only as a downstream overlay.
